title: The Garden Maze
description: A hedge maze of crumbling roofs and doubling-back paths: crawl corridors, roof runs, bramble dead-ends and a final climb to the raised terrace. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

signs.text:
The formal garden gate
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

The hedge maze
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

The fountain courtyard
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

The hidden overgrown garden
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

The raised garden terrace
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The formal garden gate
rooms.lesson: Crouch the clipped corridor, hop the beds, trust the crumbling roof. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The hedge maze
rooms.lesson: The path doubles back above the fountain wall · look beneath the ivy. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The fountain courtyard
rooms.lesson: Circle the fountain, then take the crumbling terrace walk high above it. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The hidden overgrown garden
rooms.lesson: Bramble dead-ends below · the rotting causeway rides above the garden. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The raised garden terrace
rooms.lesson: Climb the gardener’s stair to the raised terrace and hold the line. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

secret_areas.name: The ivy potting chamber
